requirements.title: Allocation status actions on associated entities are restricted to dummy access
requirements.definition: During dummy argument association, allocation-status-changing actions for the associated entity or its subobject shall be taken through the dummy argument, and an entity whose allocation status is affected through the dummy is referenced only through the dummy during the invocation.

pending.allocation-action-through-dummy-only: No portable executable oracle exists for violating this program obligation: a conforming program performs allocation-status actions through the dummy or avoids them. Future source controls keep the non-dummy allocation spelling only as nonconforming contrast with no diagnostic facet.
pending.allocation-affected-reference-through-du: No portable executable oracle exists for the aliasing reference obligation; future controls use only the dummy spelling while the invocation is active and retain non-dummy references as source-control contrasts.

requirements.title: Value actions on associated entities are restricted to dummy access
requirements.definition: During dummy argument association, value-changing actions for the associated entity or its subobject shall be taken only through the dummy argument and an entity whose value is affected through the dummy is referenced only through that dummy during the invocation, except for the listed exceptions.

pending.value-action-through-dummy-only: No portable executable oracle exists for violating this aliasing program obligation; a conforming fixture mutates through the dummy and checks exact values after return, while non-dummy mutation during the call is retained only as source-control contrast.
pending.value-affected-reference-through-dummy-o: No portable executable oracle exists for this during-invocation reference restriction; future fixtures observe only post-return values and do not treat optimizer-dependent alias behavior as conformance evidence.

requirements.title: Pointer and target dummy exceptions permit non-dummy value actions and references
requirements.definition: The value-action and value-reference restrictions have exceptions for pointer dummies, qualifying scalar assumed-shape or assumed-rank TARGET dummies, and qualifying scalar actual targets for assumed-rank TARGET dummies.

pending.pointer-dummy-alias-exception: Module integer TARGET a starts at 1 and pointer p is associated with a before CALL s(p). Subroutine s has integer, POINTER dummy x; inside s, assign a = 7 through host association, read x into result1, assign x = 9, and read a into result2. Verify result1 is 7 and result2 is 9, showing the POINTER dummy exception for non-dummy value action and non-dummy reference after dummy definition.
pending.target-dummy-alias-exception: Use two TARGET dummy cases lacking INTENT(IN) and CONTIGUOUS: scalar x associated with module TARGET a initialized to 1, and assumed-shape x(:) associated with whole TARGET array arr=[1,2]. Inside the procedures assign a = 7 and arr(2) = 8 through host association, then read x and x(2); verify exact sentinels 7 and 8. The actuals are target variables, not coindexed objects and not vector-subscript sections.
pending.scalar-assumed-rank-target-exception: Module scalar TARGET a starts at 1 and is passed to an assumed-rank TARGET dummy x(..) lacking INTENT(IN). Inside the procedure assign a = 7 through host association, enter SELECT RANK(x) RANK(0), read x into a result sentinel, and verify 7; this covers the scalar-target assumed-rank exception.
